# The npm package ships without the engine's spec files

Not offered as a first issue: it is bound to the Engine 14 window and lands in the same release as its generator half, neomjs/create-app#76.

## Context

The first step of point 5 of #21213 ("the package ships less"). Every `npm i neo.mjs` writes the engine's own regression suite into the workspace.

Measured on 2026-11-18 at `dev` `bdfc6a71ce` with `npm pack --dry-run --json`, the report's `files[]` grouped by path. Compressed is the group as its own tar through `gzip -9`; by that instrument the whole package is 24.02 MiB.

| Block | Files | Unpacked | Compressed |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| The whole package | 6,646 | 51.09 MiB | 23.61 MiB (npm's figure) |
| `*.spec.mjs` | 1,111 | 13.69 MiB | 3.04 MiB |
| `apps/portal` | 1,295 | 6.47 MiB | 2.94 MiB |
| `resources/examples` | 998 | 13.21 MiB | 12.42 MiB |
| The package after this change, by the real pack | 5,529 | 37.26 MiB | 20.48 MiB (npm's figure) |

File counts are of the committed tree. Until 2026-11-18T07:32Z this table said 6,650 and 5,533: the filer's working tree packs four seat-local files more, hidden from git only by `.git/info/exclude` and a global git ignore, which npm does not read; the review of the pull request counted the committed tree.

All 1,111 spec files lie under `test/playwright/`: unit 741, e2e 244, component 123, visual 2, clipboard 1. The rule also drops the six visual baselines, which Playwright keeps in folders named after the spec file (`__screenshots__/<name>.spec.mjs/`); the pack showed it, not the reading.

## The Problem

The spec files are 17 % of the package's files and 27 % of its unpacked size, and one consumer outside this repository runs them: the four test commands the generator writes into a workspace. Those commands run the engine's Playwright configs out of `node_modules/neo.mjs`, and each config's `testDir` is the engine's own tree (`playwright.config.unit.mjs:41`, `playwright.config.mjs:23`, `playwright.config.component.mjs:18`, `playwright.config.e2e.mjs:82`). They run the engine's suite; a spec the workspace writes is outside every one of those directories.

Point 5 waits for a fresh workspace showing that `test-unit` works "with the Playwright configs and fixtures alone". That cannot be shown: a config alone has nothing to run, and Playwright then ends in `Error: No tests found.` with exit status 1 (run at `bdfc6a71ce` with a filter that matches no spec). So the generator stops writing the four commands in the same release (neomjs/create-app#76, where the fork and its rows are recorded), and this leaf's witness is the consumer build plus the modules that stay.

## The Architectural Reality

- `package.json` declares no `files`. The hand-written header of `.npmignore` decides what ships, and `prepack` appends a copy of `.gitignore` to it (`buildScripts/util/npmIgnoreComposition.mjs`).
- `buildScripts/util/check-package-contents.mjs` runs the real pack and reds on `FORBIDDEN_PREFIXES`, two directory rules. Its spec pins that the rule set names directories only (`test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/checkPackageContents.spec.mjs:145`).
- What stays under `test/playwright/` is a consumed surface. Import statements that reach an installed engine, in `.mjs` files outside `node_modules` and `dist` of four sibling repositories (the Brain at `f84726e1e0`, the Institution at `e8477f6f99` and two private workspaces at their `dev`): `setup.mjs` 100, `fixtures.mjs` 86, `resolveFreePort.mjs` 10, `e2e/utils/workstationPopOut.mjs` 6, `e2e/utils/pngPixels.mjs` 5. No imported path ends in `.spec.mjs`; the same matcher (`neo\.mjs/test/…` inside `from`, `import(` or `resolve(`) found the 207 statements above, so it reaches the tree a spec import would sit in.
- No packed module outside the spec files imports one: `(from|import\()\s*['"][^'"]*\.spec\.mjs['"]` over `*.mjs` except `*.spec.mjs` at `bdfc6a71ce` names no file, and the pattern matches a planted import line. Spec paths in `src/` and `buildScripts/` occur in comments.
- `Design authority: "The published Neo.mjs engine package contains its source files and build scripts, but not its generated /dist output or runtime dependencies."` (`learn/gettingstarted/Workspaces.md`, line 16), and point 5 of #21213, selected in Discussion 21210.

## The Fix

1. `.npmignore`, authoritative header: one rule for the class, `*.spec.mjs`, with its reason and what stays.
2. `buildScripts/util/check-package-contents.mjs`: the class becomes a rule the pack is judged by. A `suffix` rule joins the prefix rules in the same list and predicate, so a spec that ships from any folder fails the check with its reason. The module summary and the arm at line 145 of the spec then say "directories and one file class".
3. `checkPackageContents.spec.mjs`: the arms named below.
4. `buildScripts/util/check-package-contents-baseline.json`: the row for `test/playwright/visual/__screenshots__/` goes with the baselines it covered, because the ratchet reads both ways.
5. `learn/gettingstarted/Workspaces.md`: the sentence about the package's contents names the spec files and the modules that stay.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `npm run check-package-contents` passes at the head, and its pack report holds no path ending in `.spec.mjs`. The pull request body states files, unpacked size and tarball size before and after.
- [ ] Falsifier, shown in the pull request body and not committed: with the `.npmignore` rule removed, the same command exits non-zero and names the spec class with its reason.
- [ ] Unit arms: a spec under `test/playwright/unit/` and a spec outside `test/` are found; `test/playwright/setup.mjs`, `fixtures.mjs`, a Playwright config and `e2e/utils/pngPixels.mjs` pass; every rule carries a reason.
- [ ] The six visual baselines are not packed, and the image baseline holds no row for them.
- [ ] The pack report still lists `test/playwright/setup.mjs`, `fixtures.mjs`, `resolveFreePort.mjs`, `e2e/utils/workstationPopOut.mjs`, `e2e/utils/pngPixels.mjs` and the Playwright configs.
- [ ] `Consumer Runtime Build` is green on the pull request; its path filter includes `.npmignore`.
- [ ] `learn/gettingstarted/Workspaces.md` says what the package holds of the test tree.
- [ ] Post-merge, for the notes' owner (#21032): the 14.0 notes carry the upgrade line.

## Out of Scope

- `apps/portal`. The deployed site is built from the Portal inside the installed package (`neomjs/pages`, `buildScripts/updateNeoVersion.mjs`), and the consumer build check compiles it as its specimen. It can leave after the site takes the Portal from the release tag.
- `resources/examples`, 52 % of the compressed package. It waits for the decision on `copy-examples` (#21213).
- The 216 other files that stay under `test/`.
- A `files` allowlist in `package.json`, set aside in #17240 as a ticket of its own.
- The generator's commands and the scaffold's `@playwright/test`: neomjs/create-app#76 and `#68` there.

## Avoided Traps

- **A rule pinned to today's folder** (`/test/playwright/**/*.spec.mjs`). A spec added elsewhere would ship; the class is the contract (the failure shape of #17240).
- **Dropping `test/` whole.** Five modules in it are imported from installed copies 207 times.
- **Reading the ignore rule instead of the pack.** The guard exists because that failed twice (#17240, #17251).
